# IQRA Digital School

Pakistani Curriculum. International Learning Standards.

> IQRA Digital School (اقرا ڈیجیٹل اسکول) is a free-to-start online learning platform for Pakistani students from Playgroup to Grade 10 (F.A to follow), in Urdu and English. Mission: bring Pakistan's national curriculum and education online so learning is easy and reaches every kind of learner, building a bright, educated Pakistan.

## What it offers
- Games, short lessons, notes, quizzes and books based on the national curriculum
- Subjects: Urdu, English, Mathematics, General Science, Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Computer Science, Pakistan Studies, Social Studies, Islamiat, Ethics, General Knowledge, Quran (Tajweedi Qaida), Arts, Physical Education, Financial Literacy, Digital Literacy, Communication Skills, Environmental Awareness
- Stages: Early Years (Playgroup to Prep), Primary (1-5), Middle (6-8), Secondary (9-10); F.A / Intermediate to follow in a later phase
- Regions: Punjab, Sindh, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Balochistan, Islamabad (Federal), Gilgit-Baltistan, Azad Jammu and Kashmir
- Library of official board and publisher books, plus Notes and Past Papers sections
